biography: I’m a strategic and solutions-driven Real Estate Development and M&A professional with over a decade of experience leading high-impact infrastructure initiatives across the Americas. Currently, I serve as a Data Center M&A Manager at Microsoft, where I drive global site acquisition, infrastructure delivery, and real estate strategy to support cloud capacity and hyperscale growth.My expertise spans the full lifecycle of mission-critical infrastructure — from site selection, due diligence, and entitlement through execution, integration, and long-term value creation. I’ve successfully led development efforts for portfolios exceeding $500M in value, collaborating with cross-functional teams across Legal, Engineering, Tax, and Construction to meet aggressive timelines and technical objectives.What sets me apart is my ability to blend strategic vision with executional excellence. I excel in fast-paced environments, aligning diverse stakeholders, mitigating risk, and turning complexity into clarity.
